title: Sorted GCD Pair Queries
summary: Given an integer array nums and queries, compute the sorted GCD of all pairs (nums[i], nums[j]) where 0 <= i < j < n.
statement: Given an integer array nums and queries, compute the sorted GCD of all pairs (nums[i], nums[j]) where 0 <= i < j < n. For each query, return the GCD value at the specified index in the sorted GCD array.
constraints: nums has 2–100,000 values in 1..50,000 and every query indexes its n(n-1)/2 unordered pairs.
Sort all pairwise greatest common divisors conceptually in ascending order.
Return the GCD at every zero-based queried rank without materializing the pairs.
reference_solution:
def sorted_gcd_pair_queries(nums,queries):
    import bisect
    maximum=max(nums);frequency=[0]*(maximum+1)
    for value in nums:frequency[value]+=1
    exact=[0]*(maximum+1)
    for divisor in range(maximum,0,-1):
        count=sum(frequency[multiple] for multiple in range(divisor,maximum+1,divisor))
        exact[divisor]=count*(count-1)//2-sum(exact[multiple] for multiple in range(2*divisor,maximum+1,divisor))
    cumulative=[];total=0
    for value in exact:total+=value;cumulative.append(total)
    return [bisect.bisect_right(cumulative,query) for query in queries]
